observation.command:
cd /workspace
for s in plausibility-notes fpp comment; do
  echo "===================== $s ====================="
  # get a good chunk of recent logs
  curl -s "http://localhost:8080/process/logs/$s/0/60" | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import json,sys,re
d=json.load(sys.stdin)['logs']
# strip ANSI
for l in d:
    l=re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m','',l)
    # print only interesting lines: skip pure 'GET 200 /docs executed'
    if 'GET 200: /docs' in l: continue
    print(l)
" | tail -25
  echo
done
